entry.name: Deep Learning Specialization
entry.note: Five courses from dense networks through sequence models; the standard second step

covers: Foundations of deep learning and building a first deep neural network
Initialization strategies, regularization, batch normalization and optimization algorithms
Hyperparameter tuning and diagnosing bias and variance
Visual detection and recognition and neural style transfer
Sequence models and character-level language modeling
NLP with word embeddings and transformers
Running a machine learning project and diagnosing errors in an ML system
reading.format: The program is delivered as five courses. The page mentions lecture videos, quizzes, ungraded labs and programming work in Python and TensorFlow.
reading.summary: The Deep Learning Specialization is a foundational program from DeepLearning.AI, created and taught by Andrew Ng. It spans five courses that cover how neural networks work and how to build and train them. Learners work with Python and TensorFlow on computer vision and natural language tasks. The page states that more than 1 million learners have taken the program and that it is rated 4.9 out of 5 by over 120,000 reviewers.
reading.audience: The page says it is for anyone who wants a rigorous foundation in deep learning rather than a surface-level tour. It names software engineers moving into AI, data scientists who want to understand what happens under the hood, and early-career or aspiring ML engineers building an industry portfolio.
reading.prerequisites: The page says you should be comfortable with Python and basic linear algebra. Prior machine learning experience helps but is not required.
